mapper.select: select distinct p.code as permissionCode from sys_permission p join sys_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.id join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rp.role_id join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0 and p.status = 1 and p.deleted = 0
select distinct r.code as roleCode from sys_role r join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0
select distinct p.code as permissionCode from sys_permission p join sys_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.id where rp.role_id = #{roleId} and p.status = 1 and p.deleted = 0

SELECT r.id AS role_id, r.name AS role_name, r.code AS role_code, r.description AS role_description, r.status AS role_status, r.create_time AS role_create_time, r.update_time AS role_update_time, p.id AS perm_id, p.name AS perm_name, p.code AS perm_code, p.module AS perm_module, p.description AS perm_description, p.status AS perm_status, p.create_time AS perm_create_time, p.update_time AS perm_update_time FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.id, p.id
